base: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one Steam achievement icon for TCG Card Chaos, square. Create a polished colorful casual game achievement badge for completing shelf tasks. Full-bleed deep navy blue background, rounded square thick golden beveled frame, central three cream trading cards with a simple gold diamond suit on each, neatly arranged standing on a short dark shelf. Friendly clean 3D vector-like rendering, precise bold silhouettes readable at tiny 64px. Large exact white number "2" in the lower third, perfectly legible, not overlapping card symbols. Bronze and gold accents, small restrained celebratory glints. No other text, no logo, no real trading card brand, no extra numbers, no watermark. Symmetric centered composition and generous padding. Output a square PNG at 256x256 if supported. This is the first icon in a coherent collection of numbered shelf achievement badges.
